jobs.title: Data Analytics Graduate Program
jobs.snippet: The Data Graduate Program is a two-year rotational program where you'll gain hands-on experience in key data-driven areas, rotating through teams focused on data manipulation, insight communication, and stakeholder engagement.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: As a Data Scientist within Tabcorp's Trading and Data team, you will play a key role in shaping how the company uses data and intelligent systems to make smarter decisions, reporting into a senior leader and leading end-to-end machine learning initiatives — from experimentation through to production — delivering models and systems that directly influence customer experience and measurable business impact.

jobs.title: Data Graduate Program
jobs.snippet: As a graduate with Essential Energy, you will be working as part of a supportive team to kick start your career with their three-year program. The company works with determined, passionate, and curious people to shape a green energy future.

jobs.title: 资深CV算法专家（基础模型方向）
jobs.snippet: 负责AIGC基础模型（文生图、图生图、图像编辑模型）的后训练体系建设，包括SFT、DPO、GRPO等强化学习方法设计与实现；构建大规模指令数据，用于人像生成、人像编辑、图像修复、目标消除、视频编辑等方向的SFT微调；设计奖励模型（Reward Model）；负责从通用基础模型到手机影像场景的能力迁移；提升模型对用户指令的理解能力

jobs.title: 大模型推理优化工程师
jobs.snippet: 配合模型应用和模型训练同事，上线大模型推理服务，推动大模型相关算法的落地；持续跟进前沿技术，优化大模型推理性能，提升线上模型服务吞吐量，降低模型推理延迟，控制推理机器成本；开发和优化大模型推理系统，提升模型推理系统的性能、稳定性、可观测性、易用性等；使用GPU编程和系统优化手段实现高性能的推理优化算法，并将其落地于大模型推理系统中。要求具备高性能计算、AI编译器、计算机科学、数值分析优化等相关教育背景，硕士及以上学历。
